_README: PLACEHOLDER SEED DATA for the proof of concept. These schools are FICTIONAL, so nobody mistakes the sample prompts for real ones. Replace them with the 25-40 real schools from plans.md, copying requirements and prompts from each school's official 2026-27 page and filling in source_url + last_verified. Topics must come from server/src/topics.js. Re-running `npm run seed` updates schools by name without wiping users' data.
